function.name: sports_ranking_get_top_ranked
function.description: Get the current top ranked athlete for a specific sport. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sport.description: The sport to get the ranking for.

year.description: The year for which the ranking is required.

message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes of all time. Born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, he rose to prominence as a high‑school phenom at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School, where he was named the USA Today High School Player of the Year and led his team to a state championship.

He entered the NBA directly from high school, being selected first overall by the Cleveland Cavaliers in the 2003 draft. LeBron quickly became known for his combination of size, athleticism, and basketball IQ, earning the nickname “King James.” Over his career, he has played for the Cleveland Cavaliers (two stints), the Miami Heat, and the Los Angeles Lakers.

Key highlights include:

- **NBA Championships**: Four titles (2007, 2012, 2013, 2020) – two with Miami, one with Cleveland, and one with Los Angeles.
- **MVP Awards**: Four regular‑season MVPs (2009, 2010, 2012, 2013) and two Finals MVPs (2012, 2013).
- **All‑Star Appearances**: 19 selections, including multiple All‑NCAA teams.
- **Scoring & Playmaking**: Known for his scoring ability, passing, and defensive versatility; he has averaged over 27 points per game in his career.
- **Off‑court Impact**: LeBron is also a philanthropist, entrepreneur, and media personality. He founded the LeBron James Family Foundation, which opened the “I Promise” school in Akron, and he has produced films and television shows through his company SpringHill Entertainment.

LeBron’s influence extends beyond the court; he is a cultural icon, a vocal advocate for social justice, and a role model for many aspiring athletes.
